name: Man-Thing

abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Kritik hasarını tamamen sınırlar, çok dayanıklı. Dövüş boyunca pustula bonusu zırh kırma ve zehire dönüşür — zehire immün ve doğrudan ikincil hasarlı şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Strength of The Swamp
Activating a Special Attack grant Man-Thing a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing [10 - 12]% of missing Health over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Made of Mush - Passive
content: Man-Thing is made of swamp mush, and lacks any meaningful weak points to exploit, this makes it Immune to Armor Break or Shatter effects, and prevents Critical Hits from dealing bonus Damage.
Man-Thing's lack of blood also makes it Immune to Bleed effects.

abilitySections.title: Empathic Agitation - Passive
content: Man-Thing reacts to powerful emotions, gaining +5 Agitation when struck by any attack, when hitting a Buffed Opponent with a Medium Attack, or when Nullifying a Buff. Max Agitation 100.
As Man-Thing's Agitation grows so does its Attack, gaining up to [9,582] Attack based on Agitation.
Agitation falls off over time, falling off faster the longer it's been since it last increased.
If the Opponent is a #Villain or has an active Buff, Man-Thing will wait 5 second(s) after each increase before Agitation begins to fall off.

abilitySections.title: Acidic Secretions - Passive
content: As a Defender, when Man-Thing makes contact with the Opponent during a Basic Attack, it has up to a 25% chance based on its current Agitation to Nullify a Buff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Toxic Pustules - Buff
content: Any Buff other than a Toxic Pustule Nullified on the Opponent has a 100% chance to become a Toxic Pustule lasting for 15 seconds.
Whenever a Toxic Pustule Buff is Nullified it has a 100% chance to burst becoming a Poison Debuff and an Armor Break Debuff.
The Poison Debuff does [8,863.35] damage over 15 seconds, and reduces Regeneration effects by 30%.
The Armor Break Debuff reduces Armor by [305.56] and lasts 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: 100% Chance to gain an Unstoppable Buff for 1 second(s). Cooldown: 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to Nullify each Toxic Pustule Buff on the Opponent. Armor Break and Poison Debuffs caused by bursting Toxic Pustules with this ability have 50% increase potency.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: When Activating a Special Attack Man-Thing has a 100% Chance to place a Toxic Pustule Buff on the Opponent lasting 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% Chance on Contact, to place a Toxic Pustule Buff on the Opponent lasting 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% Chance to Nullify up to 2 Buff(s) per Hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% Chance to grant a Fury Buff increasing Attack by up to [7,665.6] based on Agitation for 30 seconds.
100% Chance to place a Poison Debuff on the Opponent causing up to [14,133.45] damage based on Agitation over 20 seconds, and reducing all Regeneration by 30%.
100% Chance to place 2 Toxic Pustule Buffs on the Opponent lasting 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Strength of The Swamp
content: Activating a Special Attack grant Man-Thing a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing [10 - 12]% of missing Health over 10 seconds.
